objective: Construct one deterministic, outcome-blind historical E-event development dataset inside the already-consumed fold0/fold1/fold2 security universe, sufficient for later evidence-anchored candidate development if and only if the source information gate passes.

time_scope.window_rule: For each of the eight 2023-2024 calendar quarters, anchor on each listed joint-session ordinal and query anchor through anchor+6 calendar days inclusive.

development_universe.admission_rule: A candidate filing may be selected only when canonical_security_id exists in exactly one admitted manifest.
development_universe.known_source_invalid_semantics: Identity may remain in the source-only dataset if its filing evidence is valid, but later price/outcome attachment must preserve the pre-existing source-invalid condition and fail closed rather than substitute another security or provider merely to rescue coverage.

discovery_selection_and_classification.collector_registry: Frozen V2.8.4 18-term registry and existing SSE/SZSE public announcement routes; no term changes.
discovery_selection_and_classification.universe_filter_position: After collector deduplication and frozen triage, before deterministic selection and before PDF materialization.
discovery_selection_and_classification.security_diversity: At most one selected filing per canonical_security_id within a window.
discovery_selection_and_classification.classifier: Frozen V2.8.4 official-PDF page-scoped AI-Core classifier and aggregation semantics without changes.

temporal_provenance.date_consistency: Asia/Shanghai date derived from announcement_time must equal path_disclosure_date and official finalpage path date.
temporal_provenance.effective_date: First frozen joint A-share trading date strictly after disclosure date.

source_information_gate.threshold_origin: Reuse the already-frozen V2.8.12 prospective E information-floor geometry rather than inventing a new post-source sufficiency threshold.

required_runner_validation_before_real_c: Recompute exactly 56 windows from the frozen joint calendar using ordinals 4/12/20/28/36/44/52.
Verify all three admitted manifest file SHA256 values before use.
Verify canonical_security_id sets are pairwise disjoint; any overlap fails closed.
Verify every selected row belongs to exactly one admitted development manifest.
Verify no fold3/fold4 manifest, source path or module is referenced by the runner.
Verify input-order invariant SHA256 selection and at most one security per window.
Verify maximum six selected filings per window.
Verify temporal path/date/announcement consistency and strictly-next-joint-session effective date.
Verify source collection/classification imports no security price, benchmark, return, fold outcome or strategy-evaluator module.
Freeze runner blob SHA and a PASS validation receipt before any real historical announcement query.
forbidden: No security price, return, benchmark or transaction-cost data during source construction.
No fold3 or fold4 manifest/source access.
No reopening, mutation, expansion or relabeling of V2.8.12R.
No modification of collector terms, triage, classifier, selection caps, windows or information-floor thresholds after source results are observed.
No manual addition, replacement or removal of securities/documents to improve positive density.
No Setup, First60, Episode, live or brokerage output.

Passing this source gate does not itself authorize outcome research; one materially new candidate hypothesis, baseline, cost model, primary metric/horizon and development PASS rule must be preregistered first.
